$comment: What the Status monitor (scripts/status/check.mjs, run by .github/workflows/status.yml every 30 minutes) checks. Results are published to https://yel-hadr.github.io/status.json and shown on https://yel-hadr.github.io/status/.

monitors.name: GitHub API
monitors.$comment: A dependency of the site: the footer status widget reads it from the browser.

$serversComment: Your own servers, checked like the monitors above. Shape: { "name": "My VPS", "url": "https://vps.example.com/healthz", "method": "GET", "expectStatus": 200, "timeoutMs": 10000 }. Optional: "id" (default: from the name), "critical": true (down = outage), "slowMs". Only public URLs: the results are published.
